name: azure-vm-current
command: az vm show -g session21-homework -n session21-homework -d --query '{name:name,size:hardwareProfile.vmSize,power:powerState,ip:publicIps}' -o table

name: k3s-ready
command: ssh -i "$CAPSTONE_SSH_KEY" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile="$CAPSTONE_KNOWN_HOSTS" -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o BatchMode=yes student@"$CAPSTONE_VM_IP" 'sudo cloud-init status --wait && sudo k3s kubectl get nodes'

name: kubeconfig-tunnel
command: umask 077; ssh -i "$CAPSTONE_SSH_KEY" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile="$CAPSTONE_KNOWN_HOSTS" -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o BatchMode=yes student@"$CAPSTONE_VM_IP" 'sudo cat /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml' | sed 's/127.0.0.1:6443/127.0.0.1:18443/' > "$KUBECONFIG" && ssh -i "$CAPSTONE_SSH_KEY" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile="$CAPSTONE_KNOWN_HOSTS" -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o BatchMode=yes -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -fN -L 18443:127.0.0.1:6443 student@"$CAPSTONE_VM_IP"

name: cloud-helm-install
command: helm upgrade --install homework ./helm/taskboard -n session21 --create-namespace --set ingress.className=traefik --set ingress.host='' --wait --timeout 240s

name: cloud-running
command: kubectl -n session21 get pods,svc,ingress,hpa,pvc && helm list -n session21
